arguments.text: PLAN (min 1): 10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m out-and-back. Calib CP boat 95 W, shaft 153 W (may be 10-25% off). Start hot (shaft 225 W). Goal: settle near CP by min 3, even effort, reserve ~0 at finish, final sprint last ~400-600 m. Leg 1 into current (-0.27 m/s) so slow GPS pace on this leg is current, not paddler. Judge effort by shaft power and pod reserve (w_bal_pod_frac), not boat-speed numbers.

arguments.message: GPS speed below what pod power should give, beyond fitted current: possible weed on rudder or drag
pod reserve low with far to go
shaft power well below critical power for a minute

arguments.condition: shaft_power_w > 1.12 * cp_shaft_w and elapsed_s > 150 and remaining_m > 1500
arguments.message: still well above critical power after the start

text: no cue: start is hot as expected and the cue gate bars the first minute; set watches for drag, low reserve, effort drop and staying too hot.

arguments.text: Min 4 (670 m): settled to shaft 161 W (CP 153, sustainable 156), pod reserve 51%, boat reserve 40%. Paddler says 5/10 steady, feels fine -> CP may be underestimated (or misjudging). No cue yet. Check at ~min 12-15: if fade_pct stays ~0 and they still feel easy while above CP, consider raising cp_shaft (one of 3 uses) and asking a small push.

text: no cue: effort has settled just above critical power, close to the sustainable level; paddler feels 5/10, noted possible CP underestimate to check later.
no cue: shaft power 160 W is only about 4 W above the sustainable level and fade is slight; watching whether the pod reserve keeps draining before asking any change.

arguments.text: Ease a touch with the current, save it for upstream

Min 10 (1740 m, leg 2 downstream +0.28): shaft crept to 166 W, pod reserve 30% (drain ~3.5%/min, empties ~min 18 if held). Boat reserve 0% but no fade (+1.8%) -> boat CP 95 likely low; pod model trusted more. Paddler 6/10 fine. Cued EASE a touch (no pace target, current flips at turns). Plan: ~150-155 W downstream, ~160 upstream legs. Re-check fade + pod reserve at next wake-up; if reserve stops falling at ~158 W, CP higher.

text: Cued ease a touch on the downstream leg: shaft power 166 W was draining the pod reserve (30%) toward empty by about min 18.
no cue: the ease took effect, shaft power 155 W matches the sustainable level and the pod reserve (25%) now lasts past the finish.
